verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The captured run entered the actual Keen puzzle board, with the playable cage grid and numeric input controls visible at the same time rather than remaining on the game-selection list.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This is direct black-box game-entry evidence for the captured validation window only.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The captured before frame showed the target puzzle cell empty, and the captured after frame showed a visible green 3 in that cell after the exercised touch input sequence.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the directly observed input-to-visible-cell-state transition is promoted; puzzle-solving rules, correctness evaluation and hidden algorithms are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The package remained alive and foreground on the GamePlay activity after the exercised puzzle input, with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV or ANR marker in the validation log window.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves the captured validation window and does not claim indefinite long-run stability.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A mobile title or game-selection screen is not equivalent to gameplay entry; the first verified playable state should expose the game-specific interaction surface and controls together.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile verification, define GAME_ENTRY using visible gameplay-specific state rather than process launch or menu completion alone.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The verified puzzle state keeps the numeric action controls visible beside the active play surface so the next valid interaction is immediately available without reopening a separate menu.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: When appropriate for a Roblox mobile interaction, keep the small set of context-relevant actions directly available near the active gameplay state instead of adding unnecessary navigation layers.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The exercised input produces an immediate visible value change in the affected board cell, making the result of the touch easy to associate with the selected target.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile controls, prefer visible feedback at or near the affected gameplay object so the user can confirm that the touch produced the intended state change.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A mobile input becomes strong black-box evidence when the same gameplay state is captured immediately before and after the input and the target process remains foreground and crash-free.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Bind mobile interaction evidence to semantic before/after frames plus process, focus, fatal-crash and ANR checks; never promote screen-hash change alone.

distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.lesson: Reaching the SGTPuzzles game list proves launch and navigation progress but is not actual puzzle gameplay entry.
distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Keep selection and onboarding milestones separate from the first verified playable-state milestone.
